shortDescription: Install PTFs on the client via IBM i Network install

options.name: apply_type
options.description: The fix apply type of the install to perform.

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: device_name
options.description: The virtual optical device name on the client

options.name: fix_omit_list
options.description: The list of PTFs which will be omitted. The key of the dict should be the product ID of the fix that is omitted.

options.name: hiper_only
options.description: Whether or not only install the hiper fixes. Specify true if only need to install hiper fixes.

options.name: image_catalog_directory_name
options.description: The image catalog directory on the server The path is an IFS directory format.

options.name: joblog
options.description: The job log of the job executing the task will be returned even rc is zero if it is set to True.

options.name: operation
options.description: The operation on the client, the options are as follows setup_only will only setup the environment to install PTFs. setup_and_installPTF will setup the environment and install PTFs. installPTF_only will only install PTFs. reload will vary off and vary on the optical device when the image catalog files are updated on the server. uninstall will remove the environment on the client. setup_and_installPTF_and_uninstall will setup the environment, install PTFs and then remove the environment.

options.name: product_id
options.description: The product ID of the fixes to be installed.

options.name: rollback
options.description: Whether or not rollback if there's failure during the operation

options.name: server_address
options.description: The address of IBM i network install server It could be IP address or host name
